verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a compliance SaaS with built-in AI features (an AI Helpbot and First Pass AI), so letting those features call external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only covers the opposite role: Thoropass runs its own MCP server so external AI assistants can work inside a Thoropass workspace. Nothing shows Thoropass or its Helpbot connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, so the server-side material cannot be credited here.
